issue.title: Three-state updates gear (green updating, yellow restart queued, red last update failed)
issue.description: The gear inset at the left edge of the top bar's `updates:` badge shows at most one gear and always tells the truth: green while an update proc runs, yellow while an installed update waits for this ACE's own procs before restarting ACE and the SASE service, and red while the user's most recent update (or update-planning) attempt has failed. Each gear has a tooltip that explains it and a click target that acts on it. The red state survives ACE restarts and crashes, and every ACE instance on the machine shows it.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/update_gear_states.md requests this work

issue.title: Gear state model, three-hue palette, and the yellow restart-queued gear
issue.description: yellow-gear: add the pure gear-state model and precedence, the lime/yellow/red palette with contrast guards, and state-driven chip rendering. Make the tracked-restart wait publish a coalesced pending-restart record so the badge shows the yellow gear with a blocker tooltip and a click that opens Procs on the first blocker. Feature-flag restarts opt out.

issue.title: Durable update-attempt journal
issue.description: attempt-journal: add a best-effort, flock-guarded, atomically written JSON journal under sase_home(). It holds pure reducers for attempt start and settle, dismissal, and interrupted-attempt reconciliation (owner liveness survives execv restarts). A revisioned view feeds the UI. No UI changes.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/update_gear_states.md defines phase attempt-journal as one work unit

issue.title: Red gear lifecycle and the failure report
issue.description: red-gear: record every update-lane attempt through the journal. Session workers write start and settle markers in the worker thread before on_complete; durable update procs settle off-thread. Add an app mixin that applies revisioned views at startup, on the 10-minute tick, and after settles. Show the red gear with its tooltip, and open a new failure-report modal on click (u open Update, d dismiss, y copy).
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/update_gear_states.md defines phase red-gear as one work unit

issue.title: Update panel failure row and docs polish
issue.description: panel-failure-row: surface the recorded failure as the first Update panel (,U) row. f opens the failure report, and d dismisses in place through a panel message. The open panel refreshes when the journal view changes, and the Update-panel docs describe the row.
